summary: Build "Phoenix Predictions": a responsive FlutterFlow + Firebase web app for professional football predictions with a dark analytics theme, defined Firestore schema, core pages (Home, Match Analysis, VIP, Tickets, Results, Profile, Admin Panel), subscription-based VIP gating, payment upgrades, notifications, and an admin dashboard for managing content and results.
architectural_notes: Tech stack: FlutterFlow frontend + Firebase (Firestore) backend; must be testable on web and mobile browsers.
Firestore schema includes Users, Matches, Analysis, Tickets, Results, and optional Notifications with fields as specified.
Access control: role-based protected Admin Panel; VIP gating based on Users.subscription_type; conditional visibility for tickets/odds.
Payments: integrate PayFast + Flutterwave to upgrade subscription_type.
UI spec: Dark Analyst Theme colors (#0B0B0B background, #D4AF37 highlights, #1A1A1A cards, #EAEAEA text) and fonts (Montserrat/Poppins headings; Inter/Roboto body).
Admin Panel visibility depends on an admin flag/role on the signed-in user record; ensure the correct user is marked as admin and the UI gating checks that field consistently.
known_issues: User reports latest UI/theme updates did not apply: app still shows the old design; requires ensuring the full dark-gold theme pass is actually reflected across screens exactly as reference.
Admin dashboard/Admin Panel not visible for the user who expects admin access; likely missing/incorrect admin role flag on the user record or mismatched gating condition.

existing_features.title: Implement the Phoenix Predictions dark analytics theme across the app UI: Black (#0B0B0B) background, Gold (#D4AF37) highlights, Deep Charcoal (#1A1A1A) cards, Soft White (#EAEAEA) text; use Montserrat/Poppins-style headings and Inter/Roboto-style body fonts; ensure a clean professional dashboard/analytics layout and responsive design for mobile + desktop.
Implement authentication using Internet Identity and associate the authenticated principal with a User record (name, email, subscription_type, join_date).
Implement the required navigation and screens in this exact order/IA: Home → Match Analysis → VIP → Tickets → Results → Profile → Admin Panel, with usable navigation on both mobile and desktop.
Home Screen: show Today’s Matches and each match’s Confidence Level; provide links into the selected Match Analysis page and to the VIP section; load data by joining Matches + Analysis.

Match Analysis Page: display Form, Head-to-Head, Goal Stats, Tactical Insight, and a Confidence badge; include a VIP-only section that conditionally reveals Ticket + Odds content when the user’s subscription_type allows it; data sourced from Matches + Analysis (and Tickets when unlocked).

VIP Section: implement views for Safe Builder (3 odds), Value Accumulator (5 odds), and Odds Train (multi-day, 20–25 matches) driven by Tickets + Matches + Analysis; include an Odds Train progress bar showing completed vs remaining legs.

Tickets Page: display ticket details (ticket_type, odds, selections, status) and selection drill-down to Match Analysis; enforce the same subscription-based gating/conditional visibility rules for odds and ticket content as specified.
Results Dashboard: show win rate %, last 30 days performance, wins/losses, and streaks; compute these metrics from Results + Tickets; support filtering/overview suitable for an analytics dashboard.

Profile Page: show user info and subscription status; provide an upgrade button that initiates a payment flow for PayFast and Flutterwave and, upon confirmed success, updates the user’s subscription_type (Free / Basic / Premium).

VIP gating rules: enforce access and conditional visibility based on Users.subscription_type for VIP sections, ticket content, and odds; support tiers Free, Basic VIP, Premium VIP as described by the user (map to stored values Free/Basic/Premium while keeping user-facing labels consistent).

Confidence badges: render confidence_level with these colors: Very High → Gold, High → Green, Moderate → Orange, Low → Red, consistently across Home and Match Analysis (and anywhere else confidence is displayed).

Admin Panel (hidden/role-based): add protected admin-only pages/actions to Add Match, Add Analysis, Build Ticket, Update Results, and Track Accuracy; these actions must write to Matches, Analysis, Tickets, Results and be inaccessible to non-admin users.

Notifications system: implement an optional Notifications feature for ticket releases, results, and updates using a Notifications collection in backend storage; provide a UI to view notifications per user.

Update the global Phoenix Predictions styling so the app visually matches the uploaded reference images exactly, including: deep black background, subtle textured/gradient backdrop, gold accent lines, deep charcoal cards with gold borders/glow, and consistent typography hierarchy across all pages (Home, Match Analysis, VIP, Tickets, Results, Profile, Admin).

Resolve the theme not appearing to update by eliminating conflicting/unused global CSS tokens and ensuring there is a single source of truth for CSS variables used by Tailwind theme tokens (background/foreground/card/primary/etc.), so that the deployed UI reliably reflects the Phoenix dark-gold theme.

Refactor the AppLayout header/navigation to match the uploaded reference style: a premium dark header with gold accent treatment, Phoenix brand mark, and navigation that visually matches the reference (active states, spacing, and card-like container styling) on both desktop and mobile.

Update the Home page layout to match the uploaded reference dashboard style (remove the current centered marketing-style hero feel) and present Today’s Matches in a tighter, card-based dashboard layout consistent with the reference (card hierarchy, spacing, borders, and gold highlights) while keeping the existing data and links.

Update the VIP and Results pages styling to match the uploaded reference dashboard look: VIP option cards (Safe Builder / Value Accumulator / Odds Train) should look like prominent gold-accent tiles, and Results KPI tiles should match the reference’s card/badge style (gold for win rate emphasis, consistent spacing and borders).

Add generated static brand assets and apply them in the UI: Phoenix logo and a subtle dark textured background that matches the reference images, served as static files from the frontend (no backend image serving).

Ensure the currently authenticated user can be granted the Admin role so that the Admin Panel becomes visible and accessible (role-based/hidden admin gating). Provide a safe bootstrap path to make the user an admin when there are no admins yet, or an admin-only promotion path otherwise.
Implement Admin Panel capabilities for 'Update Results' and 'Track Accuracy' end-to-end so that admin actions write/read Results data in the backend and are usable from the Admin Panel UI.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create FlutterFlow app project "Phoenix Predictions" with responsive (mobile+desktop) dark analyst theme (black/gold), specified fonts, and dashboard/analytics layout styling
Configure Firebase/Firestore collections and fields: Users, Matches, Analysis, Tickets, Results, and optional Notifications as specified
Implement navigation and pages in required order: Home → Match Analysis → VIP → Tickets → Results → Profile → Admin Panel
Home screen: show Today’s Matches with Confidence Level; link to Match Analysis and VIP; connect to Matches + Analysis
Match Analysis page: display Form, Head-to-Head, Goal Stats, Tactical Insight, Confidence badge; VIP-only section unlocks ticket+odds; connect to Matches + Analysis
VIP section: Safe Builder (3 odds), Value Accumulator (5 odds), Odds Train (20–25 matches multi-day); connect to Tickets + Matches + Analysis; include Odds Train progress bar
Results dashboard: show win rate %, last 30 days performance, wins/losses, streaks; connect to Results + Tickets
Profile page: display user info and subscription status; upgrade button triggers payment gateways (PayFast + Flutterwave) to update subscription_type
Subscription/VIP gating: enforce visibility/access based on subscription_type (Free / Basic VIP / Premium VIP) and conditional visibility for tickets/odds
Admin Panel (role-based/hidden): add match, add analysis, build ticket, update results, track accuracy; write to Matches/Analysis/Tickets/Results
Notifications system for ticket releases, results, and updates (Firestore-backed; optional collection)
Confidence badge color mapping: Very High=Gold, High=Green, Moderate=Orange, Low=Red
Phase 2 enhancements (optional): AI assistant (ChatGPT API) for analysis/market suggestions, probability scoring display for markets, and push notifications

Create backend data models and persistent storage (in the Motoko single-actor canister) equivalent to the requested Firestore collections and fields: Users{name:string,email:string,subscription_type:Free|Basic|Premium,join_date:timestamp}; Matches{match_id:auto,league:string,teams:string,kickoff_date:timestamp}; Analysis{match_id:reference,form:array,head_to_head:array,goal_stats:object,tactical_insight:string,confidence_level:Very High|High|Moderate|Low}; Tickets{ticket_type:Safe|Value|Train,odds:float,selections:array of match_ids,status:Pending|Win|Loss}; Results{ticket_id:reference,result:Win|Loss,date_completed:timestamp,ROI:float}; Notifications(optional){user_id:reference,message:string,type:info|alert,sent_at:timestamp}.

Align backend role APIs with frontend expectations by ensuring there is a backend method to return the caller’s role (admin vs non-admin/guest) that matches the frontend’s `useCurrentUser()` usage (currently calling `getCallerUserRole()`).
